recognize_zh: 低倍 CD20 染色中，棕色陽性大細胞沿著分支的竇狀血管呈線狀、網狀分布，穿梭在陰性的造血細胞與脂肪空泡之間；這種 CD20 陽性細胞「描出血管輪廓」的圖型就是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Strong membranous CD20 in large cells distributed in linear, branching, anastomosing sinusoidal channels
Intervening hematopoietic cells and fat spaces negative
Positive cells outline vascular spaces rather than forming nodules or paratrabecular aggregates
Scattered single small CD20-positive cells in the interstitium
describe_en: CD20 immunostain of the bone marrow biopsy at low power highlights numerous large B cells distributed in a linear and branching intrasinusoidal pattern throughout the hypercellular marrow. The positive cells outline vascular channels and do not form nodular or paratrabecular aggregates, while the intervening hematopoietic cells are negative. This distinctive intravascular/intrasinusoidal distribution, which is often inconspicuous on H&E, is consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: SMZL also shows intrasinusoidal CD20+ cells but they are small lymphocytes, often accompanied by nodular aggregates, rather than large atypical cells.
Conventional DLBCL forms diffuse or nodular extravascular infiltrates rather than a purely intrasinusoidal network.
HSTCL shows an identical sinusoidal distribution but the cells are CD20 negative and CD3 positive.
